skills.name: End of Illusions (是身如幻)
skills.line: Here, slash away the inverted illusions.
skills.description: Shinigami attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

upgrades.text: Increases the damage to 120% and grants 1 stack of Flower Purge

skills.name: Falsehoods Forsaken (爱见舍离)
skills.line: Abandon all attachments of favoritism here.
skills.description:
Exclusive effect. At the start of the battle, wielding the Blade of Mercy gains 60% Effect RES; when unlocking the Blade of Judgment, additionally gains 50% Crit. When an enemy shikigami acts outside their turn, consumes 1 stack of Flower Purge to trap them in Twisted Obsession.
Active Skill: Gains 2 stacks of Flower Purge and increases own SPD by 100 for 2 turns. ;Flower Purge (花祓) : :'''General''', '''Mark''': Up to 5 stacks. For each stack consumed, gains 1 stack of Phantom Flower. ;Twisted Obsession (邪执) : :'''General''', '''Mark''': Disappears after taking action. If the bearer casts a skill, they enter Delusive Haze for 2 turns ;Phantom Flower (幻花) : :'''General''', '''Mark''': Up to five stacks. At 5 stacks, Shinigami unlocks Blade of Sentence.

upgrades.text: Wielding the Blade of Mercy gains 450 DEF.
Gains 3 stacks of Flower Purge when cast.
Wielding the Blade of Sentence, ignores 350 DEF.
Upper Hand: Gains 2 stacks of Flower Purge.

skills.name: Nirodha Present (寂灭现前)
skills.line: Life and death are fleeting, yet my heart remains serene and ever illuminating.
skills.description: Shinigami gains 2 stacks of Phantom Flower. Wielding the Blade of Mercy increases allies' Effect RES by 30% for 2 turns, and recovers HP equal to 100% of ATK for 3 allies with the lowest HP; wielding the Blade of Sentence additionally attacks the specified enemy and the 2 enemies with the lowest HP, dealing damage equal to 339% of ATK in sequence. ;Phantom Flower (幻花) : :'''General''', '''Mark''': Up to five stacks. At 5 stacks, Shinigami unlocks Blade of Sentence. ;Flower Purge (花祓) : :'''General''', '''Mark''': Up to 5 stacks. For each stack consumed, gains 1 stack of Phantom Flower.

upgrades.text: When Blade of Judgment is not unlocked, orb cost is reduced by 1
Damage multiplier to enemies in Delusive Haze is increased by 30%.
Gains 1 stack of Flower Purge when cast.
Attacks against enemies in the Delusive Haze additionally ignore 100 DEF.
